1.s: Jude urges believers to “contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints” against false teachers, recalling Israel in the wilderness, rebellious angels and Sodom. “Keep yourselves in God’s love.” It ends: “Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling…”
1.d: Jude quotes the Jewish book of 1 Enoch and alludes to a story of Michael disputing with the devil over Moses’s body. Its closing doxology is widely used in worship.
